components.role: Serves as the probabilistic component integrated into the Kolmogorov-Arnold network topology to enable scalable Bayesian inference and provide uncertainty quantification.
Provides the network architecture with learnable univariate functions on network edges, which is combined with sparse variational Gaussian process inference.
Represents the underlying prediction task addressed by the combined probabilistic architecture on scientific and vector data.

target_task.text: Regression and scientific data tasks requiring probabilistic predictions.

limitation.text: Standard Kolmogorov-Arnold networks lack probabilistic outputs and exact Gaussian process extensions scale cubically with data size.

combination.text: Integrating sparse variational Gaussian process inference with the Kolmogorov-Arnold network topology enables scalable Bayesian inference with computational complexity quasi-linear in sample size.

summary.text: Combining sparse variational Gaussian processes with Kolmogorov-Arnold network topologies addresses the limitation where standard Kolmogorov-Arnold networks lack probabilistic outputs and exact Gaussian process extensions scale cubically with data size by enabling scalable Bayesian inference with quasi-linear computational complexity in sample size for regression tasks (paper:2512.00260).

target_user.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: Machine learning practitioners and researchers working on scientific regression tasks who require scalable Bayesian inference and principled uncertainty quantification.

jtbd.text: Perform regression and scientific data tasks requiring probabilistic predictions (paper:2512.00260).

value_prop.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: Integrating sparse variational Gaussian process inference into Kolmogorov-Arnold networks provides scalable uncertainty quantification with quasi-linear complexity, preserving interpretability while offering probabilistic outputs.

riskiest_assumption.text: The riskiest assumption regarding feasibility (score 3.0 on DVF axis F) is that analytic moment matching and inducing points can successfully propagate uncertainty through deep additive Kolmogorov-Arnold network structures without prohibitive loss of accuracy or scaling bottlenecks.

mvp.text: Build a technical proof of concept combining sparse variational Gaussian processes with Kolmogorov-Arnold networks using existing packages to evaluate quasi-linear scaling and uncertainty calibration on a benchmark regression dataset.
mvp.type: technical proof of concept from existing packages

success_metric.text: Achieve a proposed threshold of negative log-likelihood improvement or well-calibrated uncertainty metrics on held-out regression test sets while maintaining quasi-linear training time scaling with sample size.

kill_criteria.text: If training time scales worse than quadratic with sample size or if uncertainty calibration metrics fail to outperform standard multi-layer perceptron baselines, the approach is killed.

open_source.use: Used for evaluating and calibrating uncertainty estimates from the probabilistic regression model.

to_build.text: An implementation integrating sparse variational Gaussian process inducing points and analytic moment matching directly into the edge-wise univariate functions of the Kolmogorov-Arnold network topology.
